summary: Flathead NF ground lookout in Flathead County, Montana; gone. Firelookout.com lists an L-4 cab for 1939, abandoned 1948; Forest Lookouts says removed, no date.

facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts says removed, no date given; firelookout.com says gone

events.note: Firelookout.com lists an L-4 cab for 1939; the page does not say the cab was built that year
Firelookout.com says the cab was abandoned in 1948
The Forest Lookouts page says the site was removed; no date given

evidence.supports: L-4 cab listed for 1939; abandoned 1948; gone
Flathead County, Flathead National Forest and land description 24N-15W-22
list entry: Bunker Point, ground, gone, at 47.82535 -113.49872

notes_for_editor: Thinnest record of the three: two short pages and one list row. No staffing, fire, builder or removal date was found. Two searches found no Bunker Point lookout source in Montana. Search results also returned Bunker Hill (a Washington lookout) and Bunker Park (a landform in Flathead County); do not mix these up.
